reason: Nine completed v0.2 tool calls used at most 103 tokens, while one malformed call continued beyond ten minutes toward the 256-token cap. A 128-token cap preserves every observed valid format and fails malformed output sooner.
resume_rule: Reuse only completed v0.2 rows whose raw output token count is at most 128; recompute every unfinished row.
hypothesis: Can the agreed harness route ten new questions to the right local conversations, give Qwen3-8B either the whole short chat or selected areas of a long chat, and return a grounded answer with exact message evidence?
pipeline: index complete visible messages while preserving conversation membership
route each new question with the union of lexical and multilingual-neural chat rankings
keep the first five routed conversations
give Qwen the whole conversation when it is at most 10000 Qwen tokens
for a longer conversation select lexical-plus-neural message areas and keep complete messages within a 10000-token reader budget
ask Qwen once per routed conversation for FOUND(claim, evidence message IDs) or EMPTY
verify mechanically that every evidence ID exists in the supplied context
review the resulting claims against the private source before publishing aggregates

long_chat_branch.area: candidate message plus its immediate previous and next complete messages

privacy: Conversation text, paths, hashes, raw model output and unreviewed claims remain private. Public output may contain only the already-public questions, aggregate states and manually reviewed safe paraphrases.
claim_boundary: The ten questions are new relative to the immutable source conversations but were used in earlier isolated routing/reader gates. This gate tests their first locked end-to-end composition, not unseen-domain generalization.
